caption: The drawing depicts a barrel-shaped ceramic dispenser with a textured surface. The main body of the dispenser is a cream or beige color with a pattern that resembles stone and is decorated with blue floral motifs and ornamental designs. The lid, which is also cream-colored, features blue flowers and has a round knob at the top. Around the middle of the dispenser, there is a rectangular panel bordered with decorative elements containing the words "Ice Water" in stylized blue text. Below this panel, the number "1" appears in a small, outlined box. At the bottom front of the dispenser is a brass or gold-colored spigot with a handle. The background of the image is plain, off-white, and unadorned.
title: Water Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
